Blue → every read, including internal reads • Green → every write/update • IDs match the usage matrix.
Internal outputs can also be inputs within a stage. Source subsets overlap; these are not extra file copies.
Expected states are requirements, not observed results. No automatic rerun or warning waiver is introduced.
Proposed exit details remain review material. Stage selection and transition approvals still apply.
